tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Looks up a US street address with the US Census Geocoder and returns the matched address with its latitude and longitude.

tools.name: get_flood_zone
tools.description: Returns the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer flood zone at a point in the United States, its subtype and whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area. Not an official flood zone determination.
